faq.q: How much does a startup website cost?
faq.a: It depends how much is custom. Setting up a template yourself costs little more than the platform subscription. A custom design and build is a one-off cost: our fixed-price plans start at $1,299 for a homepage and up to three inner pages, with the scope agreed before work starts.

faq.q: How long does it take to build a startup website?
faq.a: A custom marketing site usually takes about 3 to 6 weeks from kickoff to launch, and Framer sites are often faster. Having your copy and images ready is the biggest thing you can do to shorten it.

faq.q: Which platform is best for a startup website?
faq.a: Framer for most early-stage marketing sites, Webflow when you need a lot of structured content, and Shopify if you sell physical products. WordPress suits content-heavy businesses that will keep it maintained.

faq.q: Does a startup website need a blog at launch?
faq.a: No. Launch with a strong homepage and the pages buyers need to decide. Start a blog when you can publish useful articles regularly, because an abandoned blog makes a young company look inactive.
